hypotheses.baseline: Existing SELL-flat candidate: spread<=0.9, displacement1.8, trailing gap1R
hypotheses.spread_0_7: Reject entries with spread above 0.7 pips instead of 0.9; unchanged cost charging
hypotheses.stronger_confirmation: Displacement range threshold2.0 instead of1.8; require a stronger confirmation
hypotheses.trailing_gap_1_25: Activation stays1.5R; trail with1.25R gap instead of1R to allow larger winners. Initial SL unchanged; existing SL can only tighten.

overnight.entry_blackout: 23:55 inclusive to midnight exclusive; same gap-safe market exits as reference

plan.selection: Primary fixed GMT+3 earlier-period stressed net only; highest net, tie lower M1-close drawdown, then name. Include baseline, even if every earlier net is negative. Lock before later/full outcomes. No sample gate, parameter amendments or combinations. All scenarios reported; rankings of full results are descriptive only.
plan.cache: Reuse all12 previously completed baseline ledgers only after exact source, history, config and runtime verification; rerun all36 alternative scenarios. Baseline is never estimated by scaling or subtracting costs.
limitations: Reused historical dates; no untouched holdout or new strategy selection.
Current swap snapshot held constant over history; actual historical daily swap rates unavailable.
Broker midnight GMT+3 assumed, GMT+2 sensitivity; historical clock policy not established.
Observed spreads unchanged in stress; commission/slippage and negative swap debits doubled, credits unchanged.
Constant EUR tick valuation; margin, latency and tick extrema not reconstructed.
Swap booked before bar-open risk checks; entry at rollover exempt, exit at rollover before next bar exempt. Minute granularity.
EUR150 daily guard retained; paper aggregate exposure cap aligned to requested 0.75% per entry. Live config unchanged.
EUR100-200 winning-trade target is measured, never forced by increasing volume.

Five-minute deadline is a fixed execution convention, not an optimized parameter. Additional exits may discard winners and increase turnover. Rules are paper-only and not implemented in live execution.

Older and later data have already been examined repeatedly. Earlier-only nomination is causal within this replay but later results are not an untouched holdout. No promise of live profits or automatic deployment.
Trailed protection never moves away from entry after being tightened; increasing configured gap changes the candidate path before entry, not an already-running live position.
